what: Mouse trail: where the mouse passes becomes a tail broken into 25px square cells — each time it moves more than 1px, a 125px stamp is placed for exactly .7s (max 150, moving along with scroll). The canvas reads the stamp map once per 25px cell attached to the document and paints the cell in the tail color if the value is above .2. When it holds photo or video (media), only the bright cells the tail passes break into 25px and brighten 1.2x.
ease: none (stamp turns on, then off after .7s)

options.color: Tail color (CSS color expression), default var(--kf-surface) — the panel’s base is the element’s background-color
options.[data-fx-part=media]: (if present) video·img that breaks off at the tail — paint this image instead of the panel

from.where: shared.js pixel trail · .site-foot .foot-gl[data-trail] (footer background) · index.html .hero-preview[data-trail-video] (showreel preview video) — original WebGL touchTexture (stamp 150 · 125px · .7s, board 50 cells wide) · background · image shaders (pixelSize 25 · threshold .25 · brightness 1.2)

note: The original draws the DOM onto two fullscreen canvases (front · back) — the part lays its own canvas inside each element to produce the same picture. On touch devices · reduced motion, nothing is applied (the original is also 1024 and up only). three must be loaded first from _vendor by the consumer.
